fusions.name: Wet-Brush Lash
fusions.desc: A weapon strike wound in musk-soaked strands of your tail hair that deals 4 damage, tangles the target to slow it by 20% for 2 seconds and leaves it [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Ten Thousand Snags
fusions.desc: Whips 6 musk-soaked strands out in a spread to 6 tiles. Each strand deals 4 damage, stuns its target for 0.8 seconds and leaves it [Slowed] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Matted Mantle
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier of matted, musk-stiff fur that absorbs the next 22 damage, up to 4 blows, for 8 seconds. Your armour rises by 10% while it holds.

fusions.name: Thickening Coat
fusions.desc: When you gain health, a shield worth 10% of your maximum health closes over you for 6 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
